description.text: The major is designed to train professionals with sound scientific knowledge, basic theory and technology of the information security, basic knowledge of computer, computer skill, network security and information systems design, security management capabilities, as well as network and information security in hardware and software product development and maintenance, in government, national defense, public safety, IT enterprises and other departments and enterprises. The major is facilitated with good teaching conditions and excellent teachers. It is closely linked with communications, showing obvious development advantages and greater market demand. It is to train technology-based talents, as well as research-oriented personnel mainly in the field of network management and network security management. It pays attention to individualized training methods by fully exploiting the learning potential of students and encouraging students to learn with enthusiasm.

duration.text: The Information Security at Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/per year ￥ 15000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Certificate of HSK Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 2.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 3.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 4.High school academic transcript 5.High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization.

requirements.text: With senior high school diploma and HSK certificate of level 4 or above
